desc: **Task 1 (algorithm derivation & spec):** Reverse construction — for i = N…1, place value i into the P_i-th currently free slot of N slots; verified on samples 1 and 2.
**Task 2 (implementation):** Single-pass iterative segment tree (descend + decrement fused) for "select k-th free slot, mark occupied", plus driver and fast I/O.

**Task 3 (correctness testing):** Hand-traced N=1 (degenerate size=1, no index error), N=3 with padding leaves, and both samples; padding leaves (value 0) provably unreachable since `1 ≤ P_i ≤ i` guarantees k ≤ remaining free count.

**Task 4 (performance hardening):** O(N log N) with ~19 fused iterations per query (~1e7 simple ops at N=5·10⁵), C-speed level-by-level slice build, all hot state in locals, single bulk read and single `' '.join` write.
